The normal DaTSCAN is a critical finding, as it effectively rules out Parkinson's disease and Multiple System Atrophy, which typically show reduced dopamine transporter uptake. Given your prominent autonomic failure (incontinence, orthostatic hypotension) and parkinsonian features without DaTSCAN abnormalities, I suspect Shy-Drager syndrome or a similar autonomic failure, but the slurred speech suggests a broader neurodegenerative process; do you experience any difficulty swallowing or have you noticed significant weight loss recently?
